title: Rav Avrohom Yitzchok Mishkovsky
body: Rav Avrohom Yitzchok Mishkovsky zt”l, a renowned talmid chacham, passed away at 75. He spent decades strengthening Torah in Rechasim, serving as deputy head of the local council and maggid shiur in the Makova Yeshiva.

title: Chareidi Optimism Rises
body: Chareidi leaders Aryeh Deri and Moshe Gafni appear relaxed as discussions on the latest conscription law draft begin, a shift from months of tension.
